REASON FOR REFERRAL: Diagnostic test for Central Core Disease.

TEST

Screen for mutations in exons 95, 100, 101 and 102 of the Ryanodine receptor 1 (RYR1) gene by DNA sequencing.

RESULTS

No mutation detected.

SUMMARY
Diagnosis of Central Core disease is NOT confirmed. 

FURTHER WORK
A mutation screen of the complete RYR1 coding sequence will be set up in this laboratory in due course, however a review of individual patient?s histopathology will be required prior to further testing.
ACTA1 studies have also been requested.  This is not currently available at this laboratory but may be set up at a later date.  In the meantime if you would like us forward an aliquot of DNA to another laboratory please contact us with details.

Notes
Central Core disease is caused by dominant mutations within the Ryanodine receptor 1 (RYR1) gene. ~67% of central core disease patient have been shown to have heterozygous mutations within exons 95, 100, 101 and 102 of the RYR1 gene (Davies et. al., 2003, 13, 151-157). 

Mutation nomenclature based on RYR1 reference sequence NM_000540.2, with nucleotide number 1 corresponding to the first base of the translation initiation codon.
